name: Veranda (incl. Infinite Veranda)
notes: Edge-class Infinite Verandas: 131-184 sq ft plus 42-45 sq ft enclosed balcony area (TPG figures conflict).

name: Concierge Class
notes: Veranda layout + dedicated concierge, welcome lunch, priority dining/excursion support. Priority boarding: sources conflict (left unknown).

name: AquaClass
notes: Blu restaurant (AquaClass-exclusive), unlimited thermal suite (SEA Thermal Suite on Edge; Persian Garden on Solstice/Millennium), spa concierge. Size range varies by class.

name: The Retreat: Sky, Aqua Sky, Celebrity & Signature Suites
notes: Luminae (suite-only restaurant), Retreat Lounge (Michael's Club on Solstice/Eclipse/Reflection), butler, Premium drinks + Premium Wi-Fi. Laundry and unlimited specialty dining start at Royal Suite. Aqua Sky Suites also get thermal suite access. Retreat Sundeck not on Solstice, Eclipse, Reflection, Constellation, Infinity. Size/occupancy: Celebrity Suites sleep 4; AquaSky Suites 2.

name: The Retreat: Royal Suite & above (Royal, Penthouse, Edge Villa, Iconic)
notes: Adds unlimited specialty dining (dinner nightly, lunch on sea days), complimentary laundry + unlimited pressing, unlimited Premium drinks, personalized minibar, thermal suite. Edge Villa and Iconic Suite exist on Edge-class only. Size/occupancy: Penthouse Suites sleep 6, Royal Suites 4.

name: Ocean View
notes: Ultra Spacious Ocean View (about 319 sq ft) sleeps up to 6.

name: Balcony
notes: About 182 sq ft plus about 50 sq ft balcony (Symphony). Size/occupancy: Royal Caribbean lists balcony rooms sleeping up to 8 (family balconies).

name: Sea Class: Junior Suites
notes: Priority boarding and a dedicated check-in line. Coastal Kitchen dinner only, by reservation and space permitting; no suite lounge. Coastal Kitchen exists on Oasis, Quantum and Icon class ships.

name: Sky Class: Grand, Owner's & Sky Loft suites
notes: Concierge, suite lounge with evening drinks, all-day Coastal Kitchen, suite sun deck (The Grove on Icon class). VOOM Wi-Fi for one device per person, except Sky Junior and Sunset Junior Suites. Drinks package and laundry not included.

name: Star Class: Royal Loft, Owner's Loft, Grand Loft, Ultimate Family & Villa suites
notes: Royal Genie service, Deluxe Beverage Package, VOOM Wi-Fi, specialty dining at most venues (some items extra), complimentary laundry and pressing, gratuities included (Genie tips extra). Royal Loft sleeps 6; the Ultimate Family Suite (Symphony, Wonder, Spectrum) may sleep more. Size/occupancy: Royal Caribbean lists suites sleeping up to 8-9 (Ultimate Family Suite); Royal Loft sleeps 6.

name: Balcony
notes: Size/occupancy: About 185 sq ft plus a 35-75 sq ft balcony.

name: Cloud 9 Spa staterooms
notes: Unlimited thermal suite and thalassotherapy pool, priority spa booking. Sold as interior, ocean view, balcony and suite. Ship list from a truncated source; other ships may also have them.

name: Family Harbor staterooms
notes: Family Harbor Lounge with continental breakfast, snacks, games; kids 11 and under dine free at some venues. Size/occupancy: Family Harbor suites sleep 5.

name: Havana staterooms
notes: Private Havana pool area. All guests in the cabin must be 12 or older. Havana suites pay the suite gratuity ($19).

name: Suites (Junior, Grand, Ocean & Captain's)
notes: Priority check-in, boarding, luggage delivery, tender and debarkation. Size/occupancy: Ocean Suite about 275 sq ft plus 65 sq ft balcony.

name: Excel suites (Excel class only)
notes: Unlimited Loft 19 access (secluded top-deck area with pool and cabanas, priority cabana booking), dedicated concierge line, guaranteed specialty dining times. Reported extras: Bottomless Bubbles soda package and laundry; laundry terms unconfirmed. Size/occupancy: Excel suites about 398 sq ft up to the 1,120+ sq ft Presidential Suite (some figures include balcony).

name: Balcony
notes: Size/occupancy: About 181 sq ft plus 41 sq ft balcony (Discovery Princess).

name: Mini-Suite
notes: Size/occupancy: Some mini-suite figures include the balcony.

name: Reserve Collection mini-suites
notes: Reserve dining area with expedited seating, welcome wine, canapés on request, priority disembarkation. No lounge, no laundry. Size/occupancy: Reserve Collection mini-suites; some figures include the balcony.

name: Reserve Collection suites
notes: Reserve dining, Concierge Lounge, Suite Experience manager, complimentary laundry and professional cleaning (same-day express extra), mini-bar setup, private breakfast venue, priority disembarkation. Priority boarding not stated on the official page.

name: Sanctuary Collection (select suites and staterooms)
notes: Princess Premier is bundled in: premium drinks, unlimited specialty dining, Wi-Fi, crew appreciation, room service. Private spaces and Sanctuary Restaurant. Includes some non-suite staterooms. Sky and Enchanted Princess join in December 2026.

name: Ocean-View
notes: Size/occupancy: Family Ocean View sleeps 5.

name: Vista & Signature Suites
notes: Official suite amenities list only a no-host mini-bar, binoculars and pillow choice; no concierge, laundry or priority access.

name: Neptune Suites
notes: Neptune Lounge with concierge, complimentary laundry, pressing and dry cleaning, priority check-in, disembarkation and tender boarding. Club Orange private dining only on Pinnacle-class ships; elsewhere priority dining-room seating. Size/occupancy: Neptune Spa Suites sleep 2.

name: Pinnacle Suites (Pinnacle class only)
notes: Neptune perks plus a larger suite with separate living area; Club Orange and Pinnacle Grill breakfast. Size/occupancy: Pinnacle Suite size includes the verandah.

name: Britannia Balcony
notes: Size/occupancy: Plus a balcony of about 81 sq ft (Queen Mary 2).

name: Britannia Club
notes: Dedicated Britannia Club restaurant with single-seating dining. No Grills Lounge or Terrace. Size/occupancy: Sources range 248-470 sq ft.

name: Princess Grill suites
notes: Princess Grill restaurant (reserved table), Grills Lounge with afternoon tea, Grills Terrace. Priority boarding, concierge and laundry not confirmed (official Grills page unavailable when checked).

name: Queens Grill suites
notes: Queens Grill restaurant, Grills Lounge and Terrace, dedicated butler and steward, in-suite dining from the Queens Grill menu. Size/occupancy: Suites sleep up to 4.

name: Veranda & Ocean View Suites
notes: All-suite ship; entry suites have a sitting area. One review says The Grill by Thomas Keller carries a cover charge; most sources say all dining is included.

name: Penthouse Suites
notes: Separate living and dining area; reported to add unlimited Stream Wi-Fi and a Nespresso machine.

name: Penthouse Spa Suites
notes: Access to the Spa Serene Area and a Spa Concierge.

name: Owner's, Signature & Wintergarden Suites
notes: Expanded in-suite bar and complimentary private car transfer (up to 50 miles); some have veranda whirlpools. Size/occupancy: Wintergarden about 1,200 sq ft.

name: Club Balcony Suite
notes: One complimentary valet laundry, sparkling wine, treats twice per voyage, early dining booking. Ship list limited to Breakaway Plus and Prima-class ships; may exist on others.

name: Suites outside The Haven
notes: Core suite perks; butler and concierge vary by ship and category. Size/occupancy: Two-bedroom Family Suites sleep 6.

name: The Haven suites
notes: 24-hour butler and concierge, Haven courtyard pool and sundeck (16+), priority embarkation and tendering, Haven Restaurant on Breakaway, Breakaway Plus, Prima and Prima Plus ships. Complimentary laundry only for Owner's Suites and Garden Villas.

name: The Haven: Owner's Suites & Garden Villas
notes: Haven perks plus complimentary laundry (terms unconfirmed). Size/occupancy: Owner's Suites about 786-828 sq ft, sleep 4.

name: Inside
notes: Included wine and beer are served at lunch and dinner only.

name: Concierge Level Veranda
notes: Dedicated concierge, private Concierge Lounge, free laundry (up to 3 bags), room service from the Grand Dining Room. Aquamar Spa Terrace access on Vista and Allura.

name: Penthouse Suites
notes: Concierge Level perks plus 24-hour butler, suites-only Executive Lounge, priority luggage delivery. Spa Terrace access listed on Vista.

name: Oceania, Vista & Owner's Suites
notes: 24-hour butler, Executive Lounge, complimentary laundry up to 3 bags plus pressing on embarkation, priority luggage delivery. Size/occupancy: Oceania Suites 1,000+ sq ft; Vista Suites 1,450-1,850; Owner's Suites about 2,000.

name: Veranda Suites (Deluxe & Superior)
notes: All-suite ship. Unlimited shore excursions included.

name: Concierge Suites
notes: Free one-night pre-cruise hotel, Wi-Fi for up to 4 devices, priority online reservations, 5% off Regent Choice excursions. No butler.

name: Penthouse Suites
notes: Butler service starts at Penthouse. Size/occupancy: Up to 644 sq ft including balcony.

name: Seven Seas, Grand, Master & Regent Suites
notes: Butler service and the largest suites; the Regent Suite adds private car and guide in port. Size/occupancy: Regent Suite up to 4,443 sq ft (Seven Seas Splendor).

name: Veranda & Deluxe Veranda
notes: Wine and beer included with lunch and dinner only; Silver Spirits needed for all-day drinks. Thermal spa access included for all guests. Size/occupancy: About 224 sq ft plus 46 sq ft veranda (270 total on newer ships).

name: Penthouse Veranda
notes: Adds complimentary pressing and shoe shine. Size/occupancy: Plus 58 sq ft veranda.

name: Penthouse Junior Suite
notes: Complimentary laundry and dry cleaning. Size/occupancy: Plus 69 sq ft veranda.

name: Explorer Suite
notes: Complimentary laundry, pressing, dry cleaning and shoe shine; wraparound veranda. Size/occupancy: Plus 167-490 sq ft veranda (Viking Star); larger on newer ships.

name: Owner's Suite
notes: Explorer perks plus the Silver Spirits package and welcome champagne. Size/occupancy: Plus 156 sq ft veranda.

name: Sea Terrace
notes: Size/occupancy: Plus about 45 sq ft terrace.

name: RockStar Quarters
notes: Richard's Rooftop (suites-only lounge and deck), early VIP boarding, RockStar agent, bar tab credit. Whether gratuities are included is disputed between sources.

name: Mega RockStar Quarters
notes: Adds daily thermal suite access, pressed clothing service, private transfers and a larger bar tab (reported as bottomless; unverified).

name: Verandah
notes: Size/occupancy: Deluxe Family Verandah sleeps 5.

name: Concierge staterooms
notes: Concierge lounge with evening drinks, private sun deck (exclusive wading pool on Wish-class ships), priority boarding, early booking at 130 days. Wi-Fi for 24 hours only.

name: Concierge suites (1-bedroom and larger)
notes: Concierge perks plus Wi-Fi for the whole cruise. Size/occupancy: Sizes include the verandah. Royal Suites sleep 7-8.

name: Ocean View
notes: Size/occupancy: Family ocean-view cabins sleep up to 6.

name: Balcony
notes: Size/occupancy: Plus balcony. Family balconies sleep up to 6; connecting Super Family setups sleep more.

name: MSC Yacht Club
notes: Ship-within-a-ship: butler, concierge, Yacht Club restaurant, Top Sail Lounge, private sundeck and pool. One 2026 source says Premium Extra drinks are bundled in US fares; another prices it separately (unresolved). Not on Lirica or Musica class. Size/occupancy: Interior suites 180-226, Deluxe 269-305 (sleep 4), Royal 667-753 sq ft.

name: Ocean Terrace & Ocean Grand Terrace Suites
notes: All-suite ship with in-suite dining; no dedicated butler in entry suites.

name: Penthouses
notes: Butler service from Penthouse up (sources disagree on the threshold).

name: Residences
notes: Butler service; higher suites reported to get unlimited laundry and pressing (unconfirmed).

name: Vista & Veranda Suites
notes: Butler included even in entry suites. La Dame has a surcharge; other venues included.

name: Grand & Owner's Suites
notes: Size/occupancy: Owner's Suites about 1,500 sq ft.

name: Suites
notes: Specialty restaurants complimentary; unlimited basic Starlink Wi-Fi (1 device per guest) from 2026-04-01.

name: Top suites
notes: Suite perks plus the Ultimate Beverage Package (premium drinks) from 2026-04-01.

name: Terrace Suites
notes: Every suite has a private terrace and butler service (one source).

name: Grand, View, Loft & Owner's Suites
notes: Two-level Loft Suites (about 667 sq ft) on Evrima.

name: Deluxe Stateroom (window)
notes: Butler for every guest. Specialty restaurants included with an allotment (1 each up to 11 nights, 2 for 12-22, 3 for 23+).

name: Penthouse categories
notes: Unlimited Umi Uma and Osteria d'Ovidio. Complimentary laundry, pressing and dry cleaning reported for upper tiers (one source).

name: Ocean View Stateroom (Wind ships)
notes: Hotel service charge $16/day; Wi-Fi is part of the paid All-In package.

name: Ocean View Suite (Star ships)
notes: Star-class standard accommodation is an ocean-view suite.

name: Balcony Suite (Star ships)
notes: Balcony suites added with the Star Plus lengthening.

name: Porthole & Window Staterooms
notes: All cabins are ocean-view; category F porthole staterooms are 200 sq ft.

name: Balcony Staterooms & Veranda Suites
notes: Nearly 70% of cabins have balconies.

name: Grand & Owner's Suites
notes: Butler service from category B up.

name: Yacht Club Stateroom
notes: All meals and beverages included, wine with lunch and dinner; premium wines and top-shelf spirits extra.

name: Suites
notes: All 95 cabins are suites. Lunch, dinner and alcohol are paid a la carte.

name: Funnel Suite
notes: The largest suite.

name: Balcony
notes: Balcony cabins on Islander.

name: Suites
notes: Suite gratuity $24 per person per night.
